scope: Source-derived Fox gameplay draft, eight distinct clips; hardware review pending

modifications: Welded face duplicates by position and skin weights; averaged source texture colours at shared vertices without exchanging orange/white/dark coat regions.
Three controlled Loop-subdivision rounds on the complete original mesh cage. Ear/nose planes and sole elevation receive minimal relaxation.
Widened existing weighted distal foot vertices and eased pointed forefoot ends.
Source colour regions converted to linear vertex colours with directional grizzle; smooth normals and rough coat.
Added two small surface-projected almond eye details on native Head joint.
Connected distal paw surface reshaped; derivative limb contact animation and reach correction; see motion review.

motionReview.speedBasis: new authored world stance target, not native speed measurement

gameplayRoleProvenance.name: Attack
gameplayRoleProvenance.provenance: Authored anticipation crouch, short pounce, downward head strike, landing and braced recovery. No jaw animation or bite claim.

gameplayRoleProvenance.name: Hit
gameplayRoleProvenance.provenance: Authored rearward recoil and four-paw brace with recovery.

gameplayRoleProvenance.name: HitLeft
gameplayRoleProvenance.provenance: Authored left-side impact response: rightward trunk displacement, yaw and counter-tail, planted paws.

gameplayRoleProvenance.name: HitRight
gameplayRoleProvenance.provenance: Authored right-side impact response: leftward trunk displacement, yaw and counter-tail, planted paws.

gameplayRoleProvenance.name: Death
gameplayRoleProvenance.provenance: Authored collapse, limb folding, side roll, head/tail rest and geometry-derived body support. Final .45 seconds held motionless.
